assertion: SVG background images preserve their intrinsic aspect ratio, scale to the requested size and use the same positioning, clipping and tiling rules as raster images.

browser.reason: Reviewed all three captures and the difference images after correcting round positioning. Firefox positions the 100/3 px round tiles from their resized width, as CSS Backgrounds requires. Chrome/WebKit retain the old 40px positioning offset in the last control. Remaining Firefox differences are SVG tile seams and rounded-edge rasterization (1570 pixels, maximum channel delta 71), guarded by a strict Valle baseline.

valle.reason: Reviewed against the resized-tile formula and Firefox geometry; retain the full six-control image to catch positioning, scaling, clipping or tiling changes independently of browser rasterization allowances.
